name: Edify
summary: Immersive learning platform where trainers build VR lessons without code and host them for learners in headsets or on desktop, including through Zoom or Teams; suits universities and enterprise training.

value: Hands-on practice with 3D objects and equipment
Remote VR lessons streamed to Zoom or Teams
Teaching with imported 3D, anatomy, DICOM or GIS data
Desktop and mobile access without a headset
Branching experience builder with performance reporting
Imports of Autodesk, Zygote anatomy, DICOM and GIS content

value.evidence: Conformance reviewed against the W3C XR Accessibility User Requirements (report v1, June 2021)

researchTasks: Added from Jim's emerging technologies workbook (research snapshot 21 Nov 2026); every recorded fact re-checked against the vendor's own pages on 21 Nov 2026.
